connectors.name: Halow IO header (rear view, right edge)
connectors.orderNote: No printed pin numbers; USB connector sits beside the middle of the row, so neither end is clearly nearest; started at the top of the image (MCLR).

notes: Labels from the 'Halow IO' callout beside the rear view; the same header appears on the front view's left edge with small silkscreen. Silkscreen beside IOA7 renders like 'IGA7'/'ICA7' but the callout reads IOA7. GND pad is square (not treated as a pin-1 mark). Battery holder (+ only), Ethernet port, antenna and USB skipped.
uncertain: Pin order: the USB-C connector is level with the middle of the 10-pin header, so the USB-nearest rule does not pick an end; top-of-image rule used (MCLR = 1).
